character.name: Varg Dain

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, they can roll a d4 and add the result to the roll.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: A shimmering magical field appears around a creature within range, granting them a +2 bonus to AC for the spell’s duration.

traits: Stoic Silence: Speaks only when necessary, his words heavy with unspoken betrayal
Unyielding Honor: Refuses to lie, cheat, or harm innocents even when it would serve his goals
Guilt-Ridden: Blames himself for the treason he did not commit, convinced he failed his sacred duty
Fractured Oath: His divine powers are weakened, but he still feels compelled to protect the helpless, a remnant of his broken vow
character.gear: Weathered splint armor · Steel longsword · Oak shield · 3 dried travel rations · Healing potion · Tarnished Silver Flame holy symbol · 50 ft hempen rope · Flint and steel
character.story: Once a knight of the Silver Flame, Varg was framed for regicide by a rival lord. Stripped of title, lands, and divine favor, he wanders blighted borderlands, his oath shattered but honor intact. He carries the weight of a crime he didn’t commit, his only comforts the cold bite of his blade and the faint, fading ember of his former power. He seeks either proof to clear his name, or his traitor’s head on his sword. The secret he hides: he did break his oath, but only to stop the very treason he was framed for.

inventory.name: Steel longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for Varg’s knighting ceremony in the sacred fires of the Silver Flame temple, this blade has never failed him in battle, even after his fall from grace.
inventory.description: A well-balanced steel longsword, its pommel engraved with the crest of House Dain, now scratched and dented from years of wandering.

inventory.name: Weathered splint armor
inventory.lore: Splint armor issued to Silver Flame knights, this set bears the dents of a dozen battles and the scorch marks of the pyre where Varg was to be executed before he escaped.
inventory.description: Heavy steel splint armor, scarred and worn, the silver inlay of the Flame crest faded to a dull gray.

inventory.name: Oak shield
inventory.lore: A gift from Varg’s former liege lord, its face painted with the Silver Flame sigil. He has used it to block countless blows, and carries it as a reminder of the oath he failed.
inventory.description: A sturdy oak shield bound with iron, its painted sigil chipped and faded, but still visible to those who know what to look for.

inventory.name: Dried travel rations
inventory.lore: Stolen from a military supply caravan the day Varg fled the capital, these rations have kept him alive through weeks of wandering the wilds.
inventory.description: Tough, dry strips of preserved meat and hardtack, individually wrapped in waxed cloth.
inventory.effects: Provides enough sustenance for one day per ration.

inventory.name: Healing potion
inventory.lore: Given to Varg by a hedge witch who recognized his broken oath, it glows with a faint golden light, the only remnant of his former divine magic.
inventory.description: A small glass vial filled with a shimmering golden liquid that smells of honey and incense.

inventory.name: Tarnished Silver Flame holy symbol
inventory.lore: The holy symbol of the order that cast him out, once bright silver, now blackened and tarnished after his oath broke. It still hums faintly when he channels his remaining paladin magic.
inventory.description: A small silver medallion shaped like a rising flame, now dark and pitted, but still warm to the touch.
inventory.effects: Can be used as a spellcasting focus for paladin spells. As a bonus action, expend 1 charge to gain advantage on your next saving throw against being frightened. Regains 1d2 expended charges at dawn.

inventory.name: 50 ft hempen rope
inventory.lore: Taken from the stables of House Dain, Varg’s ancestral estate. It has been used to climb cliffs, secure camps, and even bind a traitorous servant who tried to turn him in to the crown.
inventory.description: Thick, well-woven hempen rope, frayed at one end from years of use.

inventory.name: Flint and steel
inventory.lore: A simple set given to Varg by his father when he left home to seek knighthood. It is one of the few possessions he has left from his old life.
inventory.description: A small piece of flint and a steel striker, kept in a worn leather pouch.
